items.exampleEn: A statue of a nationalist from long ago stands in the square.
items.exampleZh: 廣場上立著一尊很久以前的民族主義者雕像。
items.glossZh: 民族主義者；國家主義者

items.exampleEn: Many roadside restaurants open early in the morning.
items.exampleZh: 很多路邊餐廳一大早就開門。

items.exampleEn: Heavy snow fell in northeastern areas.
We took a boat trip across the Mediterranean last summer.
items.exampleZh: 去年夏天我們搭船橫越地中海。

items.exampleEn: Ann is the vice captain of our soccer team.
items.exampleZh: Ann 是我們足球隊的副隊長。

items.exampleEn: This old vase is from the Ming dynasty.
items.exampleZh: 這個古老的花瓶來自明朝。

items.exampleEn: From the top of the skyscraper, we could see the sea.
items.exampleZh: 從摩天大樓頂端，我們看得到海。

items.sentenceEn: The tallest skyscraper in the city has ninety floors.
items.sentenceZh: 城裡最高的摩天大樓有九十層。

items.audioEn: Tonight's film is about a nationalist leader and his early life.
items.audioZh: 今晚的電影講的是一位民族主義領袖和他早年的生活。
items.questionZh: 今晚的電影講的是什麼？

items.sentenceEn: There are many roadside stalls selling fruit.
items.sentenceZh: 有很多賣水果的路邊攤。

items.sentenceEn: Many people spend their summer holidays by the Mediterranean.
items.sentenceZh: 許多人在地中海邊度暑假。

items.stemEn: Two roads meet at a ____, and there are traffic lights there.
items.stemZh: 兩條路在十字路口交會，那裡有紅綠燈。

items.stemEn: The ____ mayor will lead the meeting while the mayor is away.
items.stemZh: 市長不在時，由副市長主持會議。

items.passageEn: Last month, my family drove through the northeastern part of the country. We stopped at roadside stalls to buy fresh fruit and honey. In one small town, we visited a museum about an old dynasty that lasted for two hundred years. At a busy crossroads, my father got lost because the signs were confusing. In the end, we reached a big city full of skyscrapers and stayed there for two nights.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們全家開車穿越該國的東北部。我們在路邊攤停下來買新鮮水果和蜂蜜。在一個小鎮，我們參觀了一座博物館，介紹一個延續了兩百年的古老王朝。在一個繁忙的十字路口，爸爸因為路標令人困惑而迷了路。最後，我們抵達一座滿是摩天大樓的大城市，在那裡住了兩晚。

questions.questionZh: 他們在小鎮參觀了什麼？

items.promptZh: 那棟摩天大樓的頂樓有一家餐廳。
referenceEn: There is a restaurant on the top floor of that skyscraper.
That skyscraper has a restaurant on its top floor.
rubricZh: 用 skyscraper 表示「摩天大樓」
「頂樓」可寫，例如 the top floor 等

referenceEn: This temple was built during the Tang dynasty.
This temple was built in the Tang dynasty.
rubricZh: 用 dynasty 表示「朝代」（例如 the Tang dynasty）
「建於」可寫，例如 was built during、was built in 等
